decision: NO_PROMOTION_IRRESPECTIVE_OF_RESULTS; requires unseen prospective formal validation

fixed_predeclared_role_model.prior: National winrate × course historical first-rate and optional racer×actual-course head backoff, training-only
fixed_predeclared_role_model.role_guarded: on hypothetical winner boat1 blend 0.25/0.15; boat2 0.18/0.10; boat3/4 0.10/0.05; boat5/6 PL
fixed_predeclared_role_model.role_head12: on hypothetical winner boat1 P2/P3 blend 0.30/0.15; boat2 0.20/0.10; other heads PL
fixed_predeclared_role_model.roles: Hypothetical head role from race-card frame only; no actual holdout course

historical_fold_not_fresh: All three folds are retrospective and historical results had been available to V147/V148 training; F3 test reused.
limitations: Pre-race race card input extraction timestamps are NOT independently verified; provenance risk remains.
The 2-course wall or current exhibition is not directly observed, only proxy features.
These candidates are evaluated on previously accessed retrospective folds; selection is exploratory and not a new independent success claim.
Training histories start 2025-11-01, not complete 1-year on early folds.
Historical race card nationality strength is treated as pre-race; no race-card scrape timestamps audited.
No automatic selection/promote based on repeated historical testing.
Conditional effect is course/frame proxy; no live 2-course wall/ST/BOATERS original exhibition integrated.
Always compare A-head, Top3, Top5 and Top10, not minimal ticket count.

v150_frozen_hypotheses.head_tail_base_cond: 1st-place racer head strength; 2nd/3rd pre-race base with small training-only conditional frequency shrinkage (mix=0.18/0.10)
v150_frozen_hypotheses.head_tail_baseline: Only 1st-place uses historical racer-course head adjustment; 2nd and 3rd use pre-race base strength
v150_frozen_hypotheses.head_tail_place: 1st-place racer head strength; 2nd/3rd pre-race base adjusted by training-only racer×actual-course respective placing rates; shrink=20 exponent=0.35
v150_frozen_hypotheses.scoring_policy: 120 permutations, no odds, no manual hole boost, no ticket-count target
v150_frozen_hypotheses.training: each fold strictly prior to holdout; no heldout course/result used as prediction feature

v151_frozen_hypotheses.diagnostics: For each model report predicted non-1 head count, false non-1 alarms, non-1 recall, non-1 precision and predicted head3/4 count
v151_frozen_hypotheses.feature_scope: Only national mean ST and reported motor/national 2-place rates from heldout race card; no result-day outcomes/actual entry/exhibition/odds
v151_frozen_hypotheses.frozen_no_tuning: No parameter grid search or best-model promotion against F1 F2 F3
v151_frozen_hypotheses.pre_head_multisignal: Require >=2 positive signs among available 2+; gain 1.05 and inside damping 0.20
v151_frozen_hypotheses.pre_head_pressure: In frames 2-4 require >=2 reported card signals; score non-1 using avg ST, motor 2-rate, national 2-rate vs frame1; fixed gain 1.5 and 1-boat inverse damping 0.38
v151_frozen_hypotheses.pre_head_pressure_cond: Same head pressure with V148 train-only conditional second/third; not a new scenario predictor

v152_frozen_hypotheses.no_best_candidate_selection: Any metric comparisons are retrospective diagnostics only; no parameters searched, no production promotion
v152_frozen_hypotheses.no_live_scenario_claim: Start timing, 2-course wall, first-turn and original exhibition not directly measured in this experiment
v152_frozen_hypotheses.role_worlds: Hypothetical head is evaluated for every one of 120 possible 3-place sequences, never inferred from actual finish or heldout entry
v152_frozen_hypotheses.world_tail_base: V151 multi-signal pre-race head, tail2/3 use unchanged national winrate + training-only global course first-rate as PL inputs
v152_frozen_hypotheses.world_tail_conditional: V151 multi-signal pre-race head; for each hypothetical head use frozen world alpha second [0.10,0.20,0.20,0.20,0.06,0.06], third [0.06,0.10,0.10,0.10,0.03,0.03]; training-only conditional finish counts
v152_frozen_hypotheses.world_tail_conditional_place: V151 multi-signal pre-race head; conditional 2nd/3rd with racer-course rank-specific tails
v152_frozen_hypotheses.world_tail_place: V151 multi-signal pre-race head; rank-specific second/third training-only racer-by-actual-course placing estimates with V150 shrinkage

v153_frozen_hypotheses.calibration: No hyperparameter grid/holdout optimization; descriptive retrospective report only
v153_frozen_hypotheses.diagnostics: ticket-head vs marginal-head disagreement frequency; accuracy within disagreement; must not force prediction to agree
v153_frozen_hypotheses.head_blend05_pl: Head pressure geometric halfway from racer actual-course strength to V151 conservative multi-signal score; both inputs race-card/history only; PL tail uses same interpolated scores
v153_frozen_hypotheses.head_blend05_place: Same head blend; training-only racer actual-course second and third priors from V150
v153_frozen_hypotheses.head_blend05_weak_cond: Same 0.50 log-domain blend; P(second|head) blend 0.12, P(third|head,second) blend 0.07 with training-only frame-level counts and pseudocount 40/25
v153_frozen_hypotheses.probability_contract: Trifecta ticket scores represent valid joint normalized probabilities; marginal head is the sum over 20 tickets, so highest-probability ticket head need not be highest marginal head; both outputs independently scored

v154_frozen_hypotheses.attack_cond: V153 weak conditional tail; conditional 3/4 head with supported 5/6 beneficiary boost fixed 1.18
v154_frozen_hypotheses.probability_invariant: Exactly 120 unique tickets, mass=1, marginal first-place mass preserved without forcing top-ticket head to match
v154_frozen_hypotheses.scenarios: Pre-race card-only escape+2-wall and 3/4 attack+5/6 beneficiary support, each >=2 observed affirmative independent signals; otherwise neutral
v154_frozen_hypotheses.scope: Retrospective exploratory only; user production gate remains locked; BOATERS original exhibition/wall is NOT measured
v154_frozen_hypotheses.wall_attack_cond: Both above, factors renormalized separately per hypothetical winning head
v154_frozen_hypotheses.wall_cond: V153 weak conditional tail and same fixed 1.25 inside-wall effect
v154_frozen_hypotheses.wall_pl: Geometric 50% head blend; PL tail reweight 1-2 within hypothetical first=1 by fixed 1.25 if escape+wall pre-signal
